title: Cell Surface Mild Acid Elution of MHC-bound Immunopeptides
author: Teesha C Luehr
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.y6ffzbn
materials: Combine all five conical tubes into one

steps.title: Prepare all required buffers
steps.instruction: Make the four solutions listed below, label them with temperature and sterility status, and keep them at the indicated temperature until use.

substeps.instruction: 1X PBS (room temperature, 25 °C): dissolve 8 g NaCl, 0.2 g KCl, 1.44 g Na₂HPO₄, 0.24 g KH₂PO₄ in 1 L Milli‑Q water, adjust pH to 7.4 with 37 % HCl, store at 25 °C.
1X PBS (cold, 4 °C): prepare the same composition as above, store at 4 °C, do NOT sterilize, and clearly mark as non‑sterile.
1X saline (phosphate‑free, 4 °C): dissolve 4 g NaCl and 0.1 g KCl in 500 mL Milli‑Q water, no pH adjustment, store at 4 °C, non‑sterile.
1X saline + 2 % acetic acid (4 °C): mix 245 mL of the above 1X saline with 5 mL glacial acetic acid (final 2 % v/v), store at 4 °C.

steps.title: Grow cells to target number
steps.instruction: Culture the chosen cell line (e.g., THP‑1) until the total viable cell count reaches 1 × 10⁸ – 2 × 10⁸ cells.

steps.title: Confirm cell count if unknown
steps.instruction: If the exact cell number is not known, perform a cell count now and verify that at least 1 × 10⁸ cells are present.

steps.title: Harvest cells into conical tubes
steps.instruction: For each 250 mL T‑175 flask, transfer the culture into five 50 mL conical tubes (one tube per ~50 mL) to enable pelleting.

steps.title: Wash cells and perform mild acid elution
steps.instruction: Subject the cell pellets to a series of washes ending with a 2 % acetic‑acid saline elution; keep all centrifugation steps at 500 g for 3 min.

substeps.instruction: Centrifuge the tubes at 500 g for 3 min (00:03:00) and discard the supernatant.
Resuspend each pellet in 5 mL room‑temperature PBS (sterile) by pipetting up and down 5 times. Re‑centrifuge at 500 g for 3 min and discard supernatant.
Resuspend in 10 mL cold PBS (4 °C) by pipetting up and down 5 times. Re‑centrifuge at 500 g for 3 min and discard supernatant.
Resuspend in another 10 mL cold PBS (4 °C) by pipetting up and down 5 times. Re‑centrifuge at 500 g for 3 min and discard supernatant.
Resuspend in 10 mL cold saline (phosphate‑free, 4 °C) by pipetting up and down 5 times. Re‑centrifuge at 500 g for 3 min and discard supernatant.
Resuspend in 10 mL cold 2 % acetic acid in saline (4 °C) by pipetting up and down 5 times. This step releases MHC‑bound peptides into the supernatant.

steps.title: Collect supernatant containing peptides
steps.instruction: Transfer the supernatant from the final acid‑elution step into a new 50 mL conical tube; this fraction contains the eluted immunopeptides.

steps.title: Transfer cells to remove phosphate
steps.instruction: Move the remaining cell pellet and any residual saline into another fresh 50 mL conical tube to eliminate remaining phosphate from the preparation.

steps.title: Record tube usage per flask
steps.instruction: Note that each 250 mL T‑175 flask requires a total of seven 50 mL conical tubes (five for initial pelleting, one for peptide‑containing supernatant, one for post‑elution cell wash).

steps.title: Desalt peptides using chosen method
steps.instruction: Proceed to peptide cleanup by desalting with the preferred technique (e.g., STAGE tip, LC‑UV, or a combination) before downstream analysis.
